title: ExpEvolve: Structuring and Reusing Experience for Open-Ended Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.29303v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evolutionary coding agents such as AlphaEvolve are one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite their success, mutations over programs are mostly low-level upon surface heuristics, without a persistent unit of control. In contrast, science compounds through ideas. translated_title: ExpEvolve：面向开放式发现的经验结构化与复用
translated_abstract: 诸如AlphaEvolve这样的进化编码代理是利用大语言模型（LLM）构建AI科学家的显著成功案例之一。这些代理通过迭代改进和演化程序来解决开放式科学问题，利用LLM的先验知识和推理能力。尽管取得了成功，但对程序的变异大多是基于表面启发式的低层级操作，缺乏持久的控制单元。相比之下，科学是通过思想实现复利式积累的。在这项工作中，我们提出了ExpEvolve，它将思想层级的提取与控制注入进化过程：它从程序中发现并利用能够解释不同程序之间评分差异的高层级因素。我们刻画了利用思想因素进行发现何时能提升样本效率的理论条件。我们还构建了一个实用框架，以展示提取出的高层级思想因素有助于指导基于经验的利用。
tldr: 提出ExpEvolve框架，将思想层级的提取与控制注入进化式编码代理，通过发现能够解释程序间评分差异的高层级思想因素并复用经验，提升开放式科学发现的样本效率。
en_tdlr: ExpEvolve injects idea-level extraction and control into evolutionary coding agents by discovering and reusing high-level factors from programs that explain scoring differences, improving sample efficiency for open-ended discovery.
